shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n 'reanchor|prettier|spec:names' package.json scripts .lore 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --stat --oneline HEAD~1
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts
rg -n \"onError|undefined|non-Error|non Error\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts specs adrs 2>/dev/null | head -120
rg -n \"catch \\(|instanceof Error|onError\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '140,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '270,390p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,130p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
cat package.json | sed -n '35,75p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
npm run spec:names -- --fix
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
git commit -m "Document non-Error onError handling"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [ "$(git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD)" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
